_about: Narration for the 30-second film. `at` is seconds on its own clock (cuts/short/edit.json). Build: make -C film short.

lines.text: NASA's SPHEREx maps the entire sky in 102 colours of infrared light.
lines.say: NASA's Sphere X maps the entire sky, in a hundred and two colours of infrared light.

lines.text: SPHEREx Explorer lets anyone search it, and blink the frames to see what moved.
lines.say: Sphere X Explorer lets anyone search it, and blink the frames to see what moved.

lines.text: Its own search finds the mover. NASA's JPL confirms it.
lines.say: Its own search finds the mover. NASA's J.P.L. confirms it.

lines.text: It even shows where SPHEREx was, and NASA WISE's moving stars.
lines.say: It even shows where Sphere X was, and NASA WISE's moving stars.

lines.text: Built on NASA data, for anyone curious enough to look.
lines.say: Built on NASA data, for anyone curious enough to look.
